Roofers in Halifax

Roofing in Halifax

Halifax and Calderdale have the steepest roofs and the heaviest weather in the county. We re-roof and repair stone terraces, mill-town cottages and valley houses across Halifax, Sowerby Bridge, Elland and Hipperholme.

Calderdale was roofed in stone slate, and a surprising amount of it is still up there. Stone slate roofs are heavy, graded and laid to shallow pitches on massive timbers, and re-covering one properly is specialist work: every slate is sorted by size and re-laid in diminishing courses on new battens and breathable membrane. We do it, and we enjoy it.

The Victorian terraces of King Cross, Pellon, Skircoat and Boothtown carry Welsh slate, often on roofs with lead valleys and parapet gutters that need skilled leadwork rather than a tube of sealant. Chimneys in Halifax are tall and exposed, and rebuilding or taking them down is a regular job for us.

The weather off the moors finds every weakness. We cover storm damage across Calderdale with 24/7 emergency call-outs, and we give you the report and photos you need for an insurance claim.

Getting to Halifax

Halifax is about half an hour from Morley by the M62. Elland, Brighouse, Hipperholme and Lightcliffe are on the near side; Sowerby Bridge, Luddenden and the upper valley are further but well within our range.

What we do in Halifax

Roofing services for Halifax homes

Roof repairs

Leaks, slipped tiles, storm damage and worn ridges fixed properly, with a straight answer on whether a repair is worth it.

Find out more

Re-roofing and new roofs

Full roof replacement in natural slate, slate-effect or concrete tile, with new membrane, battens and leadwork. 25-year guarantee.

Find out more

Flat roofs

GRP fibreglass and single-ply flat roofs for extensions, garages and dormers. Seamless, long-lasting and guaranteed for 25 years.

Find out more

Chimney repairs and rebuilds

Repointing, rebuilding, new flaunching and pots, and taking redundant stacks down below the roofline. Done while we are up there.

Find out more

Leadwork

Flashings, valleys, back gutters and soakers, hand-dressed in the right code of lead. The detail that decides whether a roof leaks.

Find out more

Dormer and loft-conversion roofs

The roofing side of loft conversions. Flat GRP dormer tops, tiled or clad cheeks, and the new roof tied back into the old one so it never leaks at the join.
